name: Copilot Studio Agent Test
description: Test a Copilot Studio agent against your own Q&A set and get a graded pass/fail report — no browser automation.
author: Matteo Pagani
coverImageAlt: A dark precision balance compares plain warm-paper and cyan answer tiles, with isolated test capsules queued beside it.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a precision quality-control balance comparing an expected-answer tile with an agent-response tile, while a short queue of isolated test capsules waits behind it, a clear metaphor for programmatic question-by-question evaluation and grading
Scene/backdrop: uncluttered warm-paper laboratory bench with a low navy backdrop and no screens or interface elements
Subject: one dark-slate mechanical balance with a warm-paper reference tile on one pan and a cyan response tile on the other; small separate capsules feed the comparison one at a time, and a restrained orange indicator bead flags a mismatch without any symbol
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; bold balance silhouette and simple paired forms legible on a small gallery card
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical, with controlled cyan backlighting and a sparing orange accent
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, question marks, check marks, crosses, interface labels, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI, browser chrome, Microsoft Fluent gradients, or Microsoft branding
Targeted correction: keep both comparison tiles and every queued capsule completely plain and solid, with no engraved lines, inset rectangles, document layouts, pseudo-text, symbols, or markings of any kind
